name: resource-status-sheets
description: Generate per-person monthly Google Sheets resource reports from DailyUpdates CSV exports.

interface.shortDescription: Monthly resource sheets from DailyUpdates CSV
interface.longDescription: Duplicate a user-provided native Google Sheets template, build deterministic per-person monthly row plans from DailyUpdates CSV, and preserve formulas and formatting while handling business-day shifts, leave, holidays, and half days.
defaultPrompt: Use $resource-status-sheets to create this month's team resource sheets.
